messages:
Priya: Hey @eng-platform — opened a tiny PR that only tweaks a sentence in runtime/README.md (docstring fix). CODEOWNERS has /runtime/ -> @org/eng-runtime so it looks blocked. Who from eng-runtime can approve/merge quickly? PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/4321

Ben: If it's truly docs-only we sometimes let docs maintainers merge, but CODEOWNERS assigning the runtime team requires a team member to approve.

Priya: Yeah it's one-line change, no code. Here is the CODEOWNERS snippet:```/runtime/ @org/eng-runtime```

Carmen: I can do it — I'm on eng-runtime rotation this week. Ping me the PR and I'll review.

Priya: Thanks @Carmen — sent a quick comment on the PR with the rationale.

merge-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #4321 — 3 green, 0 failing.

Alice: Quick Q — does this change touch any generated files or go proto? if not, I'm fine with an expeditor merge, but prefer a team member click merge.

Dan: Agreed with Alice. We avoid bypassing CODEOWNERS unless it's docs-only and super low risk. Carmen approving is the right path.

Carmen: Reviewed, LGTM. Approving now. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Awesome — thanks! Adding note in PR body: "approved-by: Carmen" per merge-bot rules.

merge-bot: Noted. Will auto-merge when status stays green and 1 codeowner approval present.

Sam: For future, if it's pure docs under runtime/, consider adding a second CODEOWNERS entry for runtime/docs/ -> @docs-team so docs folks can handle tiny fixes without pinging runtime rotation.

Priya: Good idea @Sam — I'll open a follow-up to propose that.

Carmen: Happy to review that change to CODEOWNERS. :+1:

Priya: PR merged. Thanks everyone! :tada:
